events.description: Rachel Green says Rachel Green is currently thanking Monica Geller.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing already get coffee elsewhere.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is currently asking what the mail item Rachel Green received, the country club newsletter, is.
Rachel Green says Sandra Green sends Rachel Green engagement notices from the country club newsletter for inspiration.
Rachel Green says the engagement notice in the country club newsletter is for Barry Farber and Mindy Hunter.
Monica Geller says the woman in the picture is Mindy Hunter.
Monica Geller says Mindy Hunter is pretty.
Monica Geller says Mindy Hunter was lucky to have had a friend like Rachel Green.
